claim_text: Excessive supplemental vitamin B6 intake, particularly with prolonged use, can cause sensory peripheral neuropathy; users with neurological symptoms who take B6-containing products require assessment of total dose and duration.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, context-specific assessment and prevent inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: People currently taking B6-containing supplements and reporting neurological symptoms.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental sources; verify product label and total exposure.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin B6 Health Professional Fact Sheet describes neuropathy associated with excessive supplemental B6 exposure.
limitations: Symptoms have multiple causes; do not diagnose B6 toxicity from questionnaire data alone.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
